gemini-2.5-flash.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $60,654,000 there is a deterioration of $5,306,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2020: release $1,052,000).
gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year strengthening of $68.788 million, representing 85.59% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development primarily affected the 2019 and 2020 underwriting years. The strengthening is attributed to back year deterioration on a GAAP basis, reflecting additional margins added above actuarial best estimates, and adjustments to reserving methodology based on new information from pricing current and prospective business, particularly for IBNR given the new and longer-tailed nature of the business.
raw_causal_phrases: margin added over and above actuarial best estimates, has contributed to the back year deterioration on a GAAP basis
assumptions underlying our reserving methodology reflect additional information obtained from pricing current and prospective business
implications of this analysis have been incorporated into our reserving approach for all years of account
syndicate's business is largely a new class of business with data limitations, longer tailed features and increased inherent uncertainty in the likely quantum and incidence of claims
gemini-2.5-flash.data_quality_notes: There is a discrepancy between the narrative statement of a "net deterioration of $5.306m" in claims reserves (page 20) and the "profit on the 2020 and prior years of account of $5.3m" (page 4), which implies a net release. The gross prior year development amount is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 18) as a strengthening of $68.788m, which is the most direct gross figure available. The exact reserve text reflects the net figure from the narrative. The gross premium mix is based on the statement that "All business written by the syndicate is reinsurance" as per the segmental analysis note, as no further breakdown by specific reinsurance classes is provided in the regulatory segmental analysis for the annual accounts.
